note: Hard cases for the personalize-term claim gate. Every case was chosen after reading the 2026-10-30 run or the review round 2 findings, so results on these cases are development results and cannot support a headline claim. A headline result needs the fresh blind set described in docs/evaluation.md. Saved cases point at rows in eval/results/2026-10-30.jsonl by run_id. Written cases carry their own text. 'expected' is the decision the gate should make. 'known_gap' marks a case where the gate still makes a different decision, with that decision, so the gap stays visible. 'truth' is the case's own label: correct, wrong or unsupported. 'vouch: all' means the verifier marked every sentence supported, which tests the rules that hold a claim even when the verifier vouches for it.
